steps.instruction: Press CALIBRATE on the SAFETY panel.
steps.hint: Look straight ahead at the SAFETY panel, then press CALIBRATE. Calibration centres your view so every control is within reach.
The POWER panel is on your left. Look at it until the gaze ring fills; a power bus feeds a group of systems.
Press ACK under the flashing CAUTION light. Acknowledging confirms you have seen the alarm; it does not fix the fault.

steps.instruction: Open the CHECKLIST on the POWER FAULT display.
steps.hint: Select the CHECKLIST tab on the POWER FAULT display above the POWER panel. The checklist lists every step, so nothing is missed.
The caution message names the faulted bus. Select the BUS B button, the one whose FAULT light is lit.
Turn the BUS B dial below the BUS B button until it points at ISOLATE. Isolating disconnects the bus so the fault cannot spread.
Push the CROSS-TIE breaker in until it sits flush with the panel. The cross-tie lets healthy BUS A feed the systems on BUS B.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT when the STATUS indicator shows RESTORED.
steps.hint: Check the STATUS indicator on the POWER panel reads RESTORED. REPORT is on the COMMS (communications) panel, telling mission control the fault is cleared.
